subject: [NAME] - computer vision
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently started working with LiveView Tech and Flock Safety to help
scale training data for security and surveillance vision models - similar
to [COMPANY]'s work in visual inspection.

Many CV teams hit limits with in-house or open-source tools once real-world
data grows - managing billions of CCTV frames, ensuring temporal
consistency, and handling edge cases like PPE becomes tough. We help
automate labeling, support native video annotation, and add QA workflows to
improve data quality and model accuracy at scale.

Quick context - Encord is a data development platform for advanced CV and
multimodal AI (image, video, sensor). We are $50M Series B and have helped
200+ AI teams so far.

Are you seeing similar challenges as you scale? Happy to share more over a
quick chat next week - I'm flexible Tue - Thu PT.

subject: Re: model quality and deployment speed
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working with Retrocausal's team to tackle similar challenges I'd
imagine Invisible faces i.e. keeping model quality high while moving fast
on new use cases.

They saw strong gains by tightening feedback loops between annotation and
model evaluation, verifying data faster, ensuring consistency across
annotators, and comparing new datasets to prior model outputs. It's helped
them ship improvements quicker without exposing customer data to third
parties.

Given how much of Invisible's model performance depends on high-quality
customer data, I thought it might be worth sharing how they've built
secure, internal pipelines using Encord.

Would you be open to a short intro call next week? I'm free Mon-Wed after 2
pm PT.
